title: Phase 4: Execute
use_cases: Use when implementing an iterative scene generation workflow
Implement when the AI requires a self-correction mechanism to improve script quality
Configure when incorporating a character bible and story context into active writing
Use when managing a sliding window of recent events to maintain narrative continuity
content:
Finally, we let the AI write. But even now, we keep it on a tight leash.

- The Process: We iterate through the outline scene-by-scene. For each scene, we pass in the Bible (for names/locations), the scene data (the deep analysis), and the story context (the sliding window of recent events).
- The Persona: “Ruthless Script Doctor”.

The Trick: We force a “Chain-of-Thought” workflow. The model doesn’t just output the scene; it first generates an Internal Monologue, then a Critique of potential weaknesses, then a Rewrite Plan, and only then the Final Polish. This self-correction step drastically improves quality.
